Company materials describe daily mental-baseline tracking (Wellness Score), access to therapy and discreet medication support. Headquartered in Akure, Ondo State, Nigeria per its LinkedIn company profile. Won the N20 million third-place prize in the Social Impact category at Wema Bank Hackaholics 7.0 (grand finale, Lagos, 6 November 2026). ## Harthio funding1 round The latest is a Grant announced 06 Nov 2026, led by Wema Bank. ### Who has invested in Harthio - [![Wema Bank](https://s3.amazonaws.com/startuplist.africa/investors/wema-bank.jpg)\\ \\ Wema BankLead · Grant](https://www.startuplist.africa/investors/wema-bank) | Announced | Round | Lead · investors | Amount | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 06 Nov 2026 | [Harthio Grant](https://www.startuplist.africa/funding/harthio-grant-20m-ngn-5ac435b) 06 Nov 2026
